part.text: Fixed. The page awaited `getInventory()` before rendering anything, blocking the title. Now the `<h1>` is in the static shell and inventory is wrapped in `<Suspense>`, so `/product` builds as a Partial Prerender — the title appears instantly while stock/price stream in.
